value: SPSCring: the wait-free hand-off of a connection from the listener to its operator

The single-producer single-consumer ring of int values kyr_host uses to hand each accepted socket from its listener to the operator that serves it. ECSS-E-ST-40C Rev.1 and ECSS-Q-ST-80C Rev.2, category C proposed; the requirements baseline is KYR's (the platform), the release qualified is 1.0.8.
